pending_user_directives: Use independent professional judgment; routine architecture/research decisions should be made from mission and evidence rather than pushed back to the user.
Benchmark success is subordinate to researcher understanding; do not optimize Agent benchmark scores, lead count or automated task completion as the product objective.
Historical occurrence/target time must match source-supported precision; known-time/no-lookahead eligibility is a separate conservative boundary.
Model memory/search are discovery instruments, not publishable Evidence; search not-found is not false and indirect hypotheses cannot silently become Fact/Judgment/Reality.
Claim-scoped authority controls publication; same-upstream redistributions form one evidence cluster and actual retrieval host/upstream identity must both be preserved.

Complete original PDFs redistributed or mirrored by large stable domestic or international websites are acceptable acquisition lanes when the upstream original-document identity is verifiable; the redistributor does not become a second independent authority merely by hosting the same bytes/document.

Development storage boundary: externally acquired original source/source packs belong in GitHub Release; Longcycle-generated binary state belongs in Google Drive; live PostgreSQL is never session-transported as authority.
The ADC blind archive is sealed and must remain immutable despite post-seal refinements.

Known but deferred design pressures should be discoverable through existing required manifests and referenced artifacts rather than new architecture; do not add schema merely to remember that a pressure was seen before.
Every substantive work session must update the repository handoff before returning control.
